Although the non-operating income did increase, it did not outweigh the decrease in operating income.  While the increase in cash position helps, the overall trend is worrisome. The confidence level is moderate, as the data points to potential challenges. Further investigation into the reasons for the profit decline is warranted to understand the sustainability of current operations.
